snippet.title: Lordbound - Release Date Announcement Trailer [Reupload]
snippet.description:
Reuploaded with fixed audio. :) 

Lordbound is a DLC-sized expansion mod for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Visit the valley of Druadach and embark on an epic quest to bring peace to this war-torn region. Lordbound adds a new region, three faction questlines, non-linear quests, dungeons, new weapons/armor, and more!

Join us on Discord for updates and recruitment info: https://discord.gg/WA4TMUd8F9

More information on Lordbound: 
ModDB: http://www.moddb.com/mods/lordbound 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/LordboundMod

Voiceover: Paul Warren https://x.com/NeverNotNinjas

Ending song: Musicformedhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wWzPGeSPJ-w
